item.text:
In **ResStock 2025 Release 1**:

- **Range:** Baseline heating setpoints span **55°F to 80°F**, before any offset is applied.
- **Data source:** The distribution is constructed from **U.S. EIA’s 2020 Residential Energy Consumption Survey (RECS) microdata**.
- **55°F meaning:** It identifies a **vacant housing unit**, recorded as `Tenure = 'Not Available'`, whose heating setpoint is assigned 55°F.

Sources: [2025 Release 1 Technical Reference Guide, Heating Setpoint](https://nrel.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf) and [release-specific housing characteristics documentation](https://resstock.readthedocs.io/en/2025_release_1/workflow_inputs/characteristics.html#heating-setpoint).
